dc:title: google maps language estimates
dc:description: Historical secondary compilation and deterministic geometry of printed intervals; no individual reviews, Canadian sample or significance tests.

columns.name: accuracy_percent
columns.dc:description: Google-reported correct automated decisions as a percentage of evaluated contributions; not a review-removal probability.

columns.name: ci_low_percent
columns.dc:description: Lower endpoint of Google-reported 95% interval, exactly as printed at whole-percentage precision.

columns.name: ci_high_percent
columns.dc:description: Upper endpoint of Google-reported 95% interval, exactly as printed at whole-percentage precision.

columns.name: printed_page
columns.dc:description: Printed EU DSA Report page number; differs from one-based PDF page.

columns.name: interval_width_pp
columns.dc:description: Upper minus lower endpoint, in percentage points.

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Distinguishes source estimates from derived comparisons; derived rows are not additional observations.
